messages:
Emma: Heads upCloudTail (acct CT-981) flagged INV-4910 (Mar) as disputed. They say a nightly ETL job rerouted to prod embeddings and ran ~2.8M extra tokens. Asking to avoid account hold and request a 45-day split.
Rajesh: Please paste meter dump + model IDs so I can check if reroute caused rerank/expensive model charges.
Emma: Meter link: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-4910  Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/ct-981/usage/2026-03
Jordan: CS notes: customer willing to pay 25% now, remainder over 45 days. They insist no service interruption and asked for an official payment plan document.
Sara: Recommend structured plan: 25% upfront, then three equal installments at days 15/30/45. Conditional: waive late fee for first missed payment once, after that enforce. Need dispute withdrawal for amounts covered.
Henry: Legal: will draft the plan agreement with explicit chargeback waiver and limited liability clause. Also recommend adding a clause that we can temporarily throttle if anomalous spikes recur.
Rajesh: From quick scan, majority of the extra tokens hit model redwood/embed-gen-v3 between 03:00-04:20 UTC on 2026-03-08. I'll run counts and post final numbers.
collections-bot: Dunning bot: invoice INV-4910 1st_notice at 1987654330. Warning: account hold in 10 days if unresolved.
Emma: Goal: get 25% today, signed agreement, and agree to soft throttle cap. Jordan, can you confirm payment commitment on the call?
Jordan: Scheduling call for 09:30 PT tomorrow. I'll get commitment and initial payment if they agree. Will report back in thread.
Sara: Also flag for pricing-experiments: nightly ETL patterns might need separate metering or a cheaper batch embedding SKU.
Rajesh: Will verify model IDs/token breakdown and post a short summary here after log parse.
Emma: If payment received and agreement signed, Collections marks INV-4910 as On Payment Plan and pause escalation. Jordan update after call please.
Jordan: Will update. Thanks.
